verses.original: וּפְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים נִלְחָמִ֣ים בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיָּנֻ֜סוּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מִפְּנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיִּפְּל֥וּ חֲלָלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר הַגִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·liš·tîm nil·ḥā·mîm bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yā·nu·sū ’an·šê yiś·rā·’êl mip·pə·nê p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yip·pə·lū ḥă·lā·lîm bə·har hag·gil·bō·a‘
verses.literal: Now the Philistines fought against Israel and the men of Israel fled before them and many fell slain on Mount Gilboa
verses.literalPt: OS filisteus, pois, pelejaram contra Israel; e os homens de Israel fugiram de diante dos filisteus, e caíram mortos na montanha de Gilboa.

verses.original: וַיַּדְבְּק֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים אֶת־ שָׁא֖וּל וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֑יו וַיַּכּ֣וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים אֶת־ יְהוֹנָתָ֧ן וְאֶת־ אֲבִינָדָ֛ב וְאֶת־ מַלְכִּי־ שׁ֖וּעַ בְּנֵ֥י שָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yaḏ·bə·qū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- šā·’ūl wə·’eṯ- bā·nāw way·yak·kū p̄ə·liš·tîm ’eṯ- yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·nā·ḏāḇ wə·’eṯ- mal·kî- šū·a‘ bə·nê šā·’ūl
verses.literal: The Philistines hotly pursued Saul and his sons and they killed . . . Saul’s sons Jonathan Abinadab and Malchishua
verses.literalPt: E os filisteus perseguiram a Saul e a seus filhos; e mataram a Jônatas, e a Abinadabe, e a Malquisua, filhos de Saul.

verses.original: וַתִּכְבַּ֤ד הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ אֶל־ שָׁא֔וּל וַיִּמְצָאֻ֥הוּ הַמּוֹרִ֖ים אֲנָשִׁ֣ים בַּקָּ֑שֶׁת וַיָּ֥חֶל מְאֹ֖ד מֵהַמּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tiḵ·baḏ ham·mil·ḥā·māh ’el- šā·’ūl way·yim·ṣā·’u·hū ham·mō·w·rîm ’ă·nā·šîm baq·qā·šeṯ way·yā·ḥel mə·’ōḏ mê·ham·mō·w·rîm
verses.literal: When the battle intensified against Saul the archers . . . . . . overtook him and wounded him critically
verses.literalPt: E a peleja se agravou contra Saul, e os flecheiros o alcançaram; e muito temeu por causa dos flecheiros.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שָׁאוּל֩ לְנֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜יו שְׁלֹ֥ף חַרְבְּךָ֣׀ וְדָקְרֵ֣נִי בָ֗הּ פֶּן־ יָ֠בוֹאוּ הָעֲרֵלִ֨ים הָאֵ֤לֶּה וּדְקָרֻ֙נִי֙ וְהִתְעַלְּלוּ־ בִ֔י וְלֹ֤א אָבָה֙ נֹשֵׂ֣א כֵלָ֔יו כִּ֥י יָרֵ֖א מְאֹ֑ד וַיִּקַּ֤ח שָׁאוּל֙ אֶת־ הַחֶ֔רֶב וַיִּפֹּ֖ל עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer šā·’ūl lə·nō·śê ḵê·lāw šə·lōp̄ ḥar·bə·ḵā wə·ḏā·qə·rê·nî ḇāh pen- yā·ḇō·w·’ū hā·‘ă·rê·lîm hā·’êl·leh ū·ḏə·qā·ru·nî wə·hiṯ·‘al·lə·lū- ḇî wə·lō ’ā·ḇāh nō·śê ḵê·lāw kî yā·rê mə·’ōḏ way·yiq·qaḥ šā·’ūl ’eṯ- ha·ḥe·reḇ way·yip·pōl ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer . . . Draw your sword and run me through with it or these uncircumcised men will come and run me through and torture me But his armor-bearer . . . was terrified . . . and refused to do it So Saul took his own sword and fell on it
verses.literalPt: Então disse Saul ao seu pajem de armas: Arranca a tua espada, e atravessa-me com ela, para que porventura não venham estes incircuncisos, e me atravessem e escarneçam de mim. Porém o seu pajem de armas não quis, porque temia muito; então Saul tomou a espada, e se lançou sobre ela.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥רְא נֹשֵֽׂא־ כֵלָ֖יו כִּ֣י מֵ֣ת שָׁא֑וּל וַיִּפֹּ֥ל גַּם־ ה֛וּא עַל־ חַרְבּ֖וֹ וַיָּ֥מָת עִמּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar nō·śê- ḵê·lāw kî mêṯ šā·’ūl way·yip·pōl gam- hū ‘al- ḥar·bōw way·yā·māṯ ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: When his armor-bearer . . . saw that Saul was dead he too fell on his own sword and died with him
verses.literalPt: Vendo, pois, o seu pajem de armas que Saul já era morto, também ele se lançou sobre a sua espada, e morreu com ele.

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָת שָׁא֡וּל וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָיו֩ וְנֹשֵׂ֨א כֵלָ֜יו גַּ֧ם כָּל־ אֲנָשָׁ֛יו בַּיּ֥וֹם הַה֖וּא יַחְדָּֽו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māṯ šā·’ūl ū·šə·lō·šeṯ bā·nāw wə·nō·śê ḵê·lāw gam kāl- ’ă·nā·šāw bay·yō·wm ha·hū yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: So Saul his three sons his armor-bearer . . . and all his men died together that same day
verses.literalPt: Assim faleceu Saul, e seus três filhos, e o seu pajem de armas, e também todos os seus homens morreram juntamente naquele dia.

verses.original: וַיִּרְא֣וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל אֲשֶׁר־ בְּעֵ֨בֶר הָעֵ֜מֶק וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֗ן כִּֽי־ נָ֙סוּ֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְכִי־ מֵ֖תוּ שָׁא֣וּל וּבָנָ֑יו וַיַּעַזְב֤וּ אֶת־ הֶֽעָרִים֙ וַיָּנֻ֔סוּ וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים וַיֵּֽשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶֽן׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’ū ’an·šê- yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- bə·‘ê·ḇer hā·‘ê·meq wa·’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên kî- nā·sū ’an·šê yiś·rā·’êl wə·ḵî- mê·ṯū šā·’ūl ū·ḇā·nāw way·ya·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- he·‘ā·rîm way·yā·nu·sū way·yā·ḇō·’ū p̄ə·liš·tîm way·yê·šə·ḇū bā·hen
verses.literal: When the Israelites . . . along the valley and those on the other side of the Jordan saw that the army of Israel had fled and that Saul and his sons had died they abandoned their cities and ran away So the Philistines came and occupied their cities
verses.literalPt: E, vendo os homens de Israel, que estavam deste lado do vale e deste lado do Jordão, que os homens de Israel fugiram, e que Saul e seus filhos estavam mortos, abandonaram as cidades, e fugiram; e vieram os filisteus, e habitaram nelas.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ מִֽמָּחֳרָ֔ת וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֔ים לְפַשֵּׁ֖ט אֶת־ הַחֲלָלִ֑ים וַֽיִּמְצְא֤וּ אֶת־ שָׁאוּל֙ וְאֶת־ שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת בָּנָ֔יו נֹפְלִ֖ים בְּהַ֥ר הַגִּלְבֹּֽעַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ way·yā·ḇō·’ū p̄ə·liš·tîm lə·p̄aš·šêṭ ’eṯ- ha·ḥă·lā·lîm way·yim·ṣə·’ū ’eṯ- šā·’ūl wə·’eṯ- šə·lō·šeṯ bā·nāw nō·p̄ə·lîm bə·har hag·gil·bō·a‘
verses.literal: The next day when the Philistines came to strip the dead they found Saul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa
verses.literalPt: Sucedeu, pois, que, vindo os filisteus no outro dia para despojar os mortos, acharam a Saul e a seus três filhos estirados na montanha de Gilboa.

verses.original: וַֽיִּכְרְתוּ֙ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֔וֹ וַיַּפְשִׁ֖יטוּ אֶת־ כֵּלָ֑יו וַיְשַׁלְּח֨וּ בְאֶֽרֶץ־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֜ים סָבִ֗יב לְבַשֵּׂ֛ר בֵּ֥ית עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ הָעָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·rə·ṯū ’eṯ- rō·šōw way·yap̄·šî·ṭū ’eṯ- kê·lāw way·šal·lə·ḥū ḇə·’e·reṣ- pə·liš·tîm sā·ḇîḇ lə·ḇaś·śêr bêṯ ‘ă·ṣab·bê·hem wə·’eṯ- hā·‘ām
verses.literal: They cut off Saul’s head stripped off his armor and sent messengers throughout the land of the Philistines . . . to proclaim the news in the temples of their idols and among their people
verses.literalPt: E cortaram-lhe a cabeça, e o despojaram das suas armas, e enviaram pela terra dos filisteus, em redor, a anunciá-lo no templo dos seus ídolos e entre o povo.

verses.original: וַיָּשִׂ֙מוּ֙ אֶת־ כֵּלָ֔יו בֵּ֖ית עַשְׁתָּר֑וֹת וְאֶת־ גְּוִיָּתוֹ֙ תָּקְע֔וּ בְּחוֹמַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית שָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·śi·mū ’eṯ- kê·lāw bêṯ ‘aš·tā·rō·wṯ wə·’eṯ- gə·wî·yā·ṯōw tā·qə·‘ū bə·ḥō·w·maṯ bêṯ šān
verses.literal: They put his armor in the temple of the Ashtoreths and hung his body on the wall of Beth-shan
verses.literalPt: E puseram as suas armas no templo de Astarote, e o seu corpo o afixaram no muro de Bete-Seã.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁמְע֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו יֹשְׁבֵ֖י יָבֵ֣ישׁ גִּלְעָ֑ד אֵ֛ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֥וּ פְלִשְׁתִּ֖ים לְשָׁאֽוּל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·mə·‘ū ’ê·lāw yō·šə·ḇê yā·ḇêš gil·‘āḏ ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śū p̄ə·liš·tîm lə·šā·’ūl
verses.literal: When the people of Jabesh-gilead . . . heard . . . what the Philistines had done to Saul
verses.literalPt: Ouvindo então os moradores de Jabes-Gileade, o que os filisteus fizeram a Saul,

verses.original: וַיָּק֜וּמוּ כָּל־ אִ֣ישׁ חַיִל֮ וַיֵּלְכ֣וּ כָל־ הַלַּיְלָה֒ וַיִּקְח֞וּ אֶת־ גְּוִיַּ֣ת שָׁא֗וּל וְאֵת֙ גְּוִיֹּ֣ת בָּנָ֔יו מֵחוֹמַ֖ת בֵּ֣ית שָׁ֑ן וַיָּבֹ֣אוּ יָבֵ֔שָׁה וַיִּשְׂרְפ֥וּ אֹתָ֖ם שָֽׁם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qū·mū kāl- ’îš ḥa·yil way·yê·lə·ḵū ḵāl hal·lay·lāh way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- gə·wî·yaṯ šā·’ūl wə·’êṯ gə·wî·yōṯ bā·nāw mê·ḥō·w·maṯ bêṯ šān way·yā·ḇō·’ū yā·ḇê·šāh way·yiś·rə·p̄ū ’ō·ṯām šām
verses.literal: all their men of valor set out journeyed all night and retrieved the bodies of Saul and his sons from the wall of Beth-shan When they arrived at Jabesh they burned the bodies there
verses.literalPt: Todo o homem valoroso se levantou, e caminharam toda a noite, e tiraram o corpo de Saul e os corpos de seus filhos do muro, de Bete-Seã, e, vindo a Jabes, os queimaram.

verses.original: וַיִּקְחוּ֙ אֶת־ עַצְמֹ֣תֵיהֶ֔ם וַיִּקְבְּר֥וּ תַֽחַת־ הָאֶ֖שֶׁל בְּיָבֵ֑שָׁה וַיָּצֻ֖מוּ שִׁבְעַ֥ת יָמִֽים׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·ḥū ’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·ṯê·hem way·yiq·bə·rū ṯa·ḥaṯ- hā·’e·šel bə·yā·ḇê·šāh way·yā·ṣu·mū šiḇ·‘aṯ yā·mîm
verses.literal: Then they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh and they fasted seven days
verses.literalPt: E tomaram os seus ossos, e os sepultaram debaixo de um arvoredo, em Jabes, e jejuaram sete dias.
